achievements.name: The Guiding Light
achievements.detail: Beat the earliest boss in the Temple of Guidance.

achievements.name: Mysterious Garden
achievements.detail: Reach Yarrow and explore the cavern that has grown into a garden.

achievements.name: A Shining City
achievements.detail: Uncover the Oasis, a glowing city waiting under the rock.

achievements.name: Ghost of the Machine
achievements.detail: Fight your way out when Vectron springs its trap.

achievements.name: Max Pickaxe
achievements.detail: Improve the pickaxe at the bench until no stronger version remains.

achievements.name: Master Collector
achievements.detail: Dig up the complete collection of forty-two artifacts.

achievements.name: Hopeless Gearhead
achievements.detail: Own every upgrade the town bench can install.

achievements.name: Challenge Caves
achievements.detail: Clear twenty of the optional challenge caves.

achievements.name: Yonker Brothers
achievements.detail: Track down the whole set of lost Yonker brothers.

achievements.name: Ultimate Trial
achievements.detail: Come through the Ultimate Trial still standing.

achievements.name: The Impossible Dream
achievements.detail: Earn a gold star in every score category on a single clear.

achievements.name: A New Frontier
achievements.detail: Complete the story and head out beside the miner you came to find.
